name: True Strike, Greater
body:
School divination; Level alchemist 2, bloodrager 2, inquisitor 2, magus 2, psychic 2, sorcerer/wizard 2
Duration 1 round/level or until discharged

This spell functions as true strike except you can expend it anytime during the spell’s duration.

Additionally, if you have multiple attacks, you can expend this spell as part of the full attack action and spread out the total bonus provided by the spell over the multiple attacks however you want. For example, if you have three attacks, you could apply 5 of the bonus to the first attack, 5 of the bonus to the second attack, and 10 to the final one.
